rule: Disagreements count only findings that compare people with the condition to people without it (direction_reference vs-disease-state; vas-disease-state read as the same). Changes after a treatment (vs-intervention) and findings with no reference (not-applicable) are not counted. A cell needs at least 2 distinct papers among those findings; exclude-flagged papers are left out.
